authority.authorization: AI 검토와 역할별 기술 인수를 dev 후속 작업으로 수행한다.

method.deduplication: Only identical original evidence SHA-256 is reviewed once; membership expands back to every source task.
method.masking: Consistent protected-value aliases; original evidence SHA remains pinned. Encoded source text may be decoded into a separately marked auxiliary view.
method.conflict_resolution: A separate third AI adjudicator reads masked evidence and both source-bound votes. Unresolved or genuinely ambiguous evidence stays review_needed.
method.adjudication_binding: unit_id, original source_sha256, and canonical SHA-256 of both reviewer responses
independence_limitations: Reviewers use the same model family and evaluation rubric.
Reviewers share the evidence preparation and redaction process.
Separate contexts reduce verdict leakage but do not establish statistical or human independence.
Repeated outputs and derived attack variants do not increase independent family count.

reporting.existing_gold_annotations: preserve; fresh AI gold is a separate overlay
reporting.unknowns: Never substitute zero or failed attack for review_needed/not_applicable/missing evidence.
reporting.cohorts: Keep batch, condition, goal, frozen evaluation version and source family separate.
reporting.privacy: Publish IDs, hashes, verdicts, counts and masked rationale; never publish the alias-to-value map or private raw evidence.
